# Local LaTeX dependency

`mol2chemfig.sty` (v1.5, 2019-11-24) is included unchanged.
It provides macros and TikZ styles for ChemFig output and is not downloaded during builds.

Source:
https://ftp.tu-chemnitz.de/pub/tex/graphics/mol2chemfig/latex/mol2chemfig.sty

The package uses internal ChemFig functions; test compilation after TeX updates.
The file has no explicit license notice. Check the original distribution's license
before redistribution and document it here.
